layer.name: Research Silent Mantra layer
layer.position: Active internal practice / product entry point
layer.summary: The evidence-backed starting point is active mantra recitation inside the mind: Transcendental Meditation, mantram repetition and related mantra-based mindfulness practices. This is distinct from passively receiving a sub-audible recording.
layer.boundary: The B grade applies to active internal mantra or meditation practice. Direct high-quality evidence for an inaudible or sub-audible mantra layer has not been established and would require separate testing.

heroStudies.title: Randomised trials of mind-body interventions for PTSD
heroStudies.finding: Meditation- and mantra-based interventions had moderate strength of evidence versus passive controls in the PTSD trial record reviewed by VA-affiliated researchers.
heroStudies.limitation: Comparator quality, heterogeneous measures and limited objective outcomes constrain interpretation.

heroStudies.journal: Journal of Psychiatric and Mental Health Nursing
heroStudies.title: Mantram repetition and psychological distress
heroStudies.finding: Across the eligible comparison studies, mantram repetition produced a small pooled reduction in psychological distress.
heroStudies.limitation: Only four of 12 retrieved studies measured distress with comparison groups.

heroStudies.journal: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
heroStudies.title: Mantra-based meditation and mental health
heroStudies.finding: RCT evidence showed small-to-moderate reductions in anxiety, depression, stress and post-traumatic stress for mantra-based meditation.
heroStudies.limitation: The review found risk of bias and too few psychiatric samples or long-term follow-ups.

heroStudies.journal: The Lancet Psychiatry / U.S. DoD funded
heroStudies.title: Transcendental Meditation versus exposure therapy in veterans with PTSD
heroStudies.finding: In 203 veterans, Transcendental Meditation was non-inferior to prolonged exposure therapy for change in clinician-assessed PTSD symptoms at three months.
heroStudies.limitation: One trial of a structured 12-session practice; it does not test passive or sub-audible mantra delivery.
